ayahs.textArabic: يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ اتَّقِ اللّٰهَ وَلَا تُطِعِ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ وَالْمُنٰفِقِيْنَ ۗاِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ عَلِيْمًا حَكِيْمًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Yā ayyuhan-nabiyyuttaqillāha wa lā tuṭi‘il-kāfirīna wal-munāfiqīn(a), innallāha kāna ‘alīman ḥakīmā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: PROPHET! Remain conscious of God, and defer not to the deniers of the truth and the hypo­crites: for God is truly all-knowing, wise.

ayahs.textArabic: وَّاتَّبِعْ مَا يُوْحٰىٓ اِلَيْكَ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ ۗاِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ خَبِيْرًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wattabi‘ mā yūḥā ilaika mir rabbik(a), innallāha kāna bimā ta‘malūna khabīrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: And follow [but] that which comes unto thee through revelation from thy Sustainer: for God is truly aware of all that you do, [O men].

ayahs.textArabic: وَّتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللّٰهِ ۗوَكَفٰى بِاللّٰهِ وَكِيْلًا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa tawakkal ‘alallāh(i), wa kafā billāhi wakīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: And place thy trust in God [alone]: for none is as worthy of trust as God.

ayahs.textArabic: مَا جَعَلَ اللّٰهُ لِرَجُلٍ مِّنْ قَلْبَيْنِ فِيْ جَوْفِهٖ ۚوَمَا جَعَلَ اَزْوَاجَكُمُ الّٰـِٕۤيْ تُظٰهِرُوْنَ مِنْهُنَّ اُمَّهٰتِكُمْ ۚوَمَا جَعَلَ اَدْعِيَاۤءَكُمْ اَبْنَاۤءَكُمْۗ ذٰلِكُمْ قَوْلُكُمْ بِاَفْوَاهِكُمْ ۗوَاللّٰهُ يَقُوْلُ الْحَقَّ وَهُوَ يَهْدِى السَّبِيْلَ
ayahs.textLatin: Mā ja‘alallāhu lirajulim min qalbaini fī jaufih(ī), wa mā ja‘ala azwājakumul-lā'ī tuẓāhirūna minhunna  ummahātikum, wa mā ja‘ala ad‘iyā'akum abnā'akum, żālikum qaulukum bi'afwāhikum, wallāhu yaqūlul-ḥaqqa wa huwa yahdis-sabīl(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: NEVER has God endowed any man with two hearts in one body: and [just as] He has never made your wives whom you may have declared to be “as unlawful to you as your mothers’ bodies” [truly] your mothers, so, too, has He never made your adopted sons [truly] your sons: these are but [figures of] speech uttered by your mouths - whereas God speaks the [absolute] truth: and it is He alone who can show [you] the right path.

ayahs.textArabic: اُدْعُوْهُمْ لِاٰبَاۤىِٕهِمْ هُوَ اَقْسَطُ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ ۚ فَاِنْ لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوْٓا اٰبَاۤءَهُمْ فَاِخْوَانُكُمْ فِى الدِّيْنِ وَمَوَالِيْكُمْ ۗوَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ فِيْمَآ اَخْطَأْتُمْ بِهٖ وَلٰكِنْ مَّا تَعَمَّدَتْ قُلُوْبُكُمْ ۗوَكَانَ اللّٰهُ غَفُوْرًا رَّحِيْمًا
ayahs.textLatin: Ud‘ūhum li'ābā'ihim huwa aqsaṭu ‘indallāh(i), fa illam ta‘lamū ābā'ahum fa ikhwānukum fid-dīni wa mawālīkum, wa laisa ‘alaikum junāḥun fīmā akhṭa'tum bihī wa lākim mā ta‘ammadat qulūbukum, wa kānallāhu gafūrar raḥīmā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [As for your adopted children,] call them by their [real] fathers’ names: this is more equitable in the sight of God; and if you know not who their fathers were, [call them] your brethren in faith and your friends. However, you will incur no sin if you err in this respect: [what really matters is] but what your hearts intend - for God is indeed much-forgiv­ing, a dispenser of grace!

ayahs.textArabic: اَلنَّبِيُّ اَوْلٰى بِالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ مِنْ اَنْفُسِهِمْ وَاَزْوَاجُهٗٓ اُمَّهٰتُهُمْ ۗوَاُولُوا الْاَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ اَوْلٰى بِبَعْضٍ فِيْ كِتٰبِ اللّٰهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُهٰجِرِيْنَ اِلَّآ اَنْ تَفْعَلُوْٓا اِلٰٓى اَوْلِيَاۤىِٕكُمْ مَّعْرُوْفًا ۗ كَانَ ذٰلِكَ فِى الْكِتٰبِ مَسْطُوْرًا
ayahs.textLatin: An-nabiyyu aulā bil-mu'minīna min anfusihim wa azwājuhū ummahātuhum, wa ulul-arḥāmi ba‘ḍuhum aulā biba‘ḍin fī kitābillāhi minal-mu'minīna wal-muhājirīna illā an taf‘alū ilā auliyā'ikum ma‘rūfā(n), kāna żālika fil-kitābi masṭūrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: The Prophet has a higher claim on the believers than [they have on] their own selves, [seeing that he is as a father to them] and his wives are their mothers: and they who are [thus] closely related have, in accordance with God’s decree, a higher claim upon one another than [was even the case between] the believers [of Yathrib] and those who had migrated [there for the sake of God]. None the less, you are to act with utmost goodness towards your [other] close friends as well: this [too] is written down in God’s decree.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذْ اَخَذْنَا مِنَ النَّبِيّٖنَ مِيْثَاقَهُمْ وَمِنْكَ وَمِنْ نُّوْحٍ وَّاِبْرٰهِيْمَ وَمُوْسٰى وَعِيْسَى ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ ۖوَاَخَذْنَا مِنْهُمْ مِّيْثَاقًا غَلِيْظًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iż akhażnā minan-nabiyyīna mīṡāqahum wa minka wa min nūḥiw wa ibrāhīma wa mūsā wa ‘īsabni maryam(a), wa akhażnā minhum mīṡāqan galīẓā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND LO! We did accept a solemn pledge from all the prophets from thee, [O Muhammad,] as well as from Noah, and Abraham, and Moses, and Jesus the son of Mary -: for We accepted a most weighty, solemn pledge from [all of] them,

ayahs.textArabic: لِّيَسْـَٔلَ الصّٰدِقِيْنَ عَنْ صِدْقِهِمْ ۚوَاَعَدَّ لِلْكٰفِرِيْنَ عَذَابًا اَلِيْمًا ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Liyas'alaṣ-ṣādiqīna ‘an ṣidqihim, wa a‘adda lil-kāfirīna ‘ażāban alīmā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: so that [at the end of time] He might ask those men of truth as to [what response] their truthfulness [had received on earth]. And grievous suffering has He readied for all who deny the truth!

ayahs.textArabic: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوا اذْكُرُوْا نِعْمَةَ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْكُمْ اِذْ جَاۤءَتْكُمْ جُنُوْدٌ فَاَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيْحًا وَّجُنُوْدًا لَّمْ تَرَوْهَا ۗوَكَانَ اللّٰهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ بَصِيْرًاۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Yā ayyuhal-lażīna āmanużkurū ni‘matallāhi ‘alaikum iż jā'atkum junūdun fa'arsalnā ‘alaihim rīḥaw wa junūdal lam tarauhā, wa kānallāhu bimā ta‘malūna baṣīrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: O YOU who have attained to faith! Call to mind the blessings which God bestowed on you (at the time) when [enemy] hosts came down upon you, where­upon We let loose against them a storm wind and [heavenly] hosts that you could not see: yet God saw all that you did.

ayahs.textArabic: اِذْ جَاۤءُوْكُمْ مِّنْ فَوْقِكُمْ وَمِنْ اَسْفَلَ مِنْكُمْ وَاِذْ زَاغَتِ الْاَبْصَارُ وَبَلَغَتِ الْقُلُوْبُ الْحَنَاجِرَ وَتَظُنُّوْنَ بِاللّٰهِ الظُّنُوْنَا۠   ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Iż jā'ūkum min fauqikum wa min asfala minkum wa iż zāgatil-abṣāru wa balagatil-qulūbul-ḥanājira wa taẓunnūna billāhiẓ-ẓunūnā.
ayahs.textEnglish: [Remember what you felt] when they came upon you from above you and from below you, and when [your] eyes became dim and [your] hearts came up to [your] throats, and [when] most conflicting thoughts about God passed through your minds:

ayahs.textArabic: هُنَالِكَ ابْتُلِيَ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ وَزُلْزِلُوْا زِلْزَالًا شَدِيْدًا
ayahs.textLatin: Hunālikabtuliyal-mu'minūna wa zulzilū zilzālan syadīdā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [for] there and then were the believers tried, and shaken with a shock severe.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذْ يَقُوْلُ الْمُنٰفِقُوْنَ وَالَّذِيْنَ فِيْ قُلُوْبِهِمْ مَّرَضٌ مَّا وَعَدَنَا اللّٰهُ وَرَسُوْلُهٗٓ اِلَّا غُرُوْرًا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iż yaqūlul-munāfiqūna wal-lażīna fī qulūbihim maraḍum mā wa‘adanallāhu wa rasūluhū illā gurūrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [remember how it was] when the hypo­crites and those with hearts diseased said [to one another], “God and His Apostle have promised us nothing but delusions!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذْ قَالَتْ طَّاۤىِٕفَةٌ مِّنْهُمْ يٰٓاَهْلَ يَثْرِبَ لَا مُقَامَ لَكُمْ فَارْجِعُوْا ۚوَيَسْتَأْذِنُ فَرِيْقٌ مِّنْهُمُ النَّبِيَّ يَقُوْلُوْنَ اِنَّ بُيُوْتَنَا عَوْرَةٌ  ۗوَمَا هِيَ بِعَوْرَةٍ ۗاِنْ يُّرِيْدُوْنَ اِلَّا فِرَارًا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iż qālat ṭā'ifatum minhum yā ahla yaṡriba lā muqāma lakum farji‘ū, wa yasta'żinu farīqum minhumun-nabiyya yaqūlūna inna buyūtanā ‘aurah(tun), wa mā hiya bi‘aurah(tin), iy yurīdūna illā firārā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and when some of them said, “O you people of Yathrib! You cannot withstand [the enemy] here: hence, go back [to your homes]!” — Whereupon a party from among them asked leave of the Prophet, saying, “Behold, our houses are exposed [to attack]!” — The while they were not [really] exposed: they wanted nothing but to flee.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَوْ دُخِلَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ مِّنْ اَقْطَارِهَا ثُمَّ سُىِٕلُوا الْفِتْنَةَ لَاٰتَوْهَا وَمَا تَلَبَّثُوْا بِهَآ اِلَّا يَسِيْرًا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lau dukhilat ‘alaihim min aqṭārihā ṡumma su'ilul-fitnata la'ātauhā wa mā talabbaṡū bihā illā yasīrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Now if their town had been stormed, and they had been asked [by the enemy] to commit apos­tasy, [the hypocrites] would have done so without much delay

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ كَانُوْا عَاهَدُوا اللّٰهَ مِنْ قَبْلُ لَا يُوَلُّوْنَ الْاَدْبَارَ ۗوَكَانَ عَهْدُ اللّٰهِ مَسْـُٔوْلًا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad kānū ‘āhadullāha min qablu lā yuwallūnal-adbār(a), wa kāna ‘ahdullāhi mas'ūlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: although ere that they had vowed before God that they would never turn their backs [on His message]: and a vow made to God must surely be answered for!

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ لَّنْ يَّنْفَعَكُمُ الْفِرَارُ اِنْ فَرَرْتُمْ مِّنَ الْمَوْتِ اَوِ الْقَتْلِ وَاِذًا لَّا تُمَتَّعُوْنَ اِلَّا قَلِيْلًا
ayahs.textLatin: Qul lay yanfa‘akumul-firāru in farartum minal-mauti awil-qatli wa iżal lā tumatta‘ūna illā qalīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: “Whether you flee from [natural] death or from being slain [in battle], flight will not profit you - for, however you fare, you are not [allowed] to enjoy life for more than a little while!”

ayahs.textArabic: قُلْ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِيْ يَعْصِمُكُمْ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ اِنْ اَرَادَ بِكُمْ سُوْۤءًا اَوْ اَرَادَ بِكُمْ رَحْمَةً ۗوَلَا يَجِدُوْنَ لَهُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ وَلِيًّا وَّلَا نَصِيْرًا
ayahs.textLatin: Qul man żal-lażī ya‘ṣimukum minallāhi in arāda bikum sū'an au arāda bikum raḥmah(tan), wa lā yajidūna lahum min dūnillāhi waliyyaw wa lā naṣīrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Say: “Who is there that could keep you away from God if it be His will to harm you, or if it be His will to show you mercy?” For, [do they not know that] besides God they can find none to protect them, and none to bring them succour?

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ قَدْ يَعْلَمُ اللّٰهُ الْمُعَوِّقِيْنَ مِنْكُمْ وَالْقَاۤىِٕلِيْنَ لِاِخْوَانِهِمْ هَلُمَّ اِلَيْنَا ۚوَلَا يَأْتُوْنَ الْبَأْسَ اِلَّا قَلِيْلًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Qad ya‘lamullāhul-mu‘awwiqīna minkum wal-qā'ilīna li'ikhwānihim halumma ilainā, wa lā ya'tūnal-ba'sa illā qalīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: God is indeed aware of those of you who would divert others [from fighting in His cause], as well as of those who say to their brethren, “Come hither to us [and face the enemy]!” — The while they [themselves] join battle but seldom,

ayahs.textArabic: اَشِحَّةً عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَاِذَا جَاۤءَ الْخَوْفُ رَاَيْتَهُمْ يَنْظُرُوْنَ اِلَيْكَ تَدُوْرُ اَعْيُنُهُمْ كَالَّذِيْ يُغْشٰى عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمَوْتِۚ فَاِذَا ذَهَبَ الْخَوْفُ سَلَقُوْكُمْ بِاَلْسِنَةٍ حِدَادٍ اَشِحَّةً عَلَى الْخَيْرِۗ اُولٰۤىِٕكَ لَمْ يُؤْمِنُوْا فَاَحْبَطَ اللّٰهُ اَعْمَالَهُمْۗ وَكَانَ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ يَسِيْرًا
ayahs.textLatin: Asyiḥḥatan ‘alaikum, fa iżā jā'al-khaufu ra'aitahum yanẓurūna ilaika tadūru a‘yunuhum kal-lażī yugsyā ‘alaihi minal-maut(i), fa iżā żahabal-khaufu salaqūkum bi'alsinatin ḥidādin asyiḥḥatan ‘alal-khair(i), ulā'ika lam yu'minū fa aḥbaṭallāhu a‘mālahum, wa kāna żālika ‘alallāhi yasīrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: begrudging you all help. But then, when danger threatens, thou canst see them looking to thee [for help, O Prophet], their eyes rolling [in terror] like [the eyes of] one who is overshadowed by death: yet as soon as the danger has passed, they will assail you [believers] with sharp tongues, begrudging you all that is good! [People like] these have never known faith - and therefore God will cause all their works to come to nought: for this is indeed easy for God.

ayahs.textArabic: يَحْسَبُوْنَ الْاَحْزَابَ لَمْ يَذْهَبُوْا ۚوَاِنْ يَّأْتِ الْاَحْزَابُ يَوَدُّوْا لَوْ اَنَّهُمْ بَادُوْنَ فِى الْاَعْرَابِ يَسْاَلُوْنَ عَنْ اَنْۢبَاۤىِٕكُمْ ۗوَلَوْ كَانُوْا فِيْكُمْ مَّا قٰتَلُوْٓا اِلَّا قَلِيْلًا ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Yaḥsabūnal-aḥzāba lam yażhabū, wa iy ya'til aḥzābu yawaddū lau annahum bādūna fil a‘rābi yas'alūna ‘an ambā'ikum, wa lau kānū fīkum mā qātalū illā qalīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: They think that the Confederates have not [really] withdrawn; and should the Confederates return, these [hypocrites] would prefer to be in the desert, among the bedouin, asking for news about you, [O believers, from far away;] and even were they to find themselves in your midst, they would but make a pretence at fighting [by your side].

ayahs.textArabic: لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِيْ رَسُوْلِ اللّٰهِ اُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ لِّمَنْ كَانَ يَرْجُوا اللّٰهَ وَالْيَوْمَ الْاٰخِرَ وَذَكَرَ اللّٰهَ كَثِيْرًاۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Laqad kāna lakum fī rasūlillāhi uswatun ḥasanatul liman kāna yarjullāha wal yaumal ākhira wa żakarallāha kaṡīrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: VERILY, in the Apostle of God you have a good example for everyone who looks forward [with hope and awe] to God and the Last Day, and remembers God unceasingly.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَمَّا رَاَ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ الْاَحْزَابَۙ قَالُوْا هٰذَا مَا وَعَدَنَا اللّٰهُ وَرَسُوْلُهٗ وَصَدَقَ اللّٰهُ وَرَسُوْلُهٗ  ۖوَمَا زَادَهُمْ اِلَّآ اِيْمَانًا وَّتَسْلِيْمًاۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lammā ra'al-mu'minūnal-aḥzāb(a), qālū hāżā mā wa‘adanallāhu wa rasūluhū wa ṣadaqallāhu wa rasūluh(ū), wa mā zādahum illā īmānaw wa taslīmā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [so,] when the believers saw the Con­federates [advancing against them], they said, “This is what God and His Apostle have promised us!”- and, “Truly spoke God and His Apostle!” and all this but increased their faith and their readiness to surrender themselves unto God.

ayahs.textArabic: مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ رِجَالٌ صَدَقُوْا مَا عَاهَدُوا اللّٰهَ عَلَيْهِ ۚ فَمِنْهُمْ مَّنْ قَضٰى نَحْبَهٗۙ وَمِنْهُمْ مَّنْ يَّنْتَظِرُ ۖوَمَا بَدَّلُوْا تَبْدِيْلًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Minal-mu'minīna rijālun ṣadaqū mā ‘āhadullāha ‘alaih(i), faminhum man qaḍā naḥbah(ū), wa minhum may yantaẓir(u), wa mā baddalū tabdīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Among the believers are men who have [always] been true to what they have vowed before God; and among them are such as have [already] redeemed their pledge by death, and such as yet await [its fulfillment] without having changed [their resolve] in the least.

ayahs.textArabic: لِّيَجْزِيَ اللّٰهُ الصّٰدِقِيْنَ بِصِدْقِهِمْ وَيُعَذِّبَ الْمُنٰفِقِيْنَ اِنْ شَاۤءَ اَوْ يَتُوْبَ عَلَيْهِمْ ۗاِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ غَفُوْرًا رَّحِيْمًاۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Liyajziyallāhuṣ-ṣādiqīna biṣidqihim wa yu‘ażżibal-munāfiqīna in syā'a au yatūba ‘alaihim, innallāha kāna gafūrar raḥīmā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Such trials are imposed upon man] so that God may reward the truthful for having been true to their word, and cause the hypocrites to suffer - if that be His will - or [if they repent,] accept their repen­tance: for, verily, God is indeed much-forgiving, a dispenser of grace!

ayahs.textArabic: وَرَدَّ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا بِغَيْظِهِمْ لَمْ يَنَالُوْا خَيْرًا ۗوَكَفَى اللّٰهُ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ الْقِتَالَ ۗوَكَانَ اللّٰهُ قَوِيًّا عَزِيْزًاۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa raddallāhul-lażīna kafarū bigaiẓihim lam yanālū khairā(n), wa kafallāhul-mu'minīnal-qitāl(a), wa kānallāhu qawiyyan ‘azīzā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Thus, for all their fury, God repulsed those who were bent on denying the truth; no advantage did they gain, since God was enough to [protect] the believers in battle - seeing that God is most powerful, almighty;

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَنْزَلَ الَّذِيْنَ ظَاهَرُوْهُمْ مِّنْ اَهْلِ الْكِتٰبِ مِنْ صَيَاصِيْهِمْ وَقَذَفَ فِيْ قُلُوْبِهِمُ الرُّعْبَ فَرِيْقًا تَقْتُلُوْنَ وَتَأْسِرُوْنَ فَرِيْقًاۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa anzalal-lażīna ẓāharūhum min ahlil-kitābi min ṣayāṣīhim wa qażafa fī qulūbihimur-ru‘ba farīqan taqtulūna wa ta'sirūna farīqā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and He brought down from their strongholds those of the followers of earlier reve­lation who had aided the aggressors, and cast terror into their hearts: some you slew, and some you made captive;

ayahs.textArabic: وَاَوْرَثَكُمْ اَرْضَهُمْ وَدِيَارَهُمْ وَاَمْوَالَهُمْ وَاَرْضًا لَّمْ تَطَـُٔوْهَا ۗوَكَانَ اللّٰهُ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرًا ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa auraṡakum arḍahum wa diyārahum wa amwālahum wa arḍal lam taṭa'ūhā, wa kānallāhu ‘alā kulli syai'in qadīrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and He made you heirs to their lands, and their houses, and their goods - and [promised you] lands on which you had never yet set foot: for God has indeed the power to will anything.

ayahs.textArabic: يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُلْ لِّاَزْوَاجِكَ اِنْ كُنْتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ الْحَيٰوةَ الدُّنْيَا وَزِيْنَتَهَا فَتَعَالَيْنَ اُمَتِّعْكُنَّ وَاُسَرِّحْكُنَّ سَرَاحًا جَمِيْلًا
ayahs.textLatin: Yā ayyuhan-nabiyyu qul li'azwājika in kuntunna turidnal-ḥayātad-dun-yā wa zīnatahā fa ta‘ālaina umatti‘kunna wa usarriḥkunna sarāḥan jamīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: O PROPHET! Say unto thy wives: “If you desire [but] the life of this world and its charms - well, then, I shall provide for you and release you in a becoming manner;

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنْ كُنْتُنَّ تُرِدْنَ اللّٰهَ وَرَسُوْلَهٗ وَالدَّارَ الْاٰخِرَةَ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ اَعَدَّ لِلْمُحْسِنٰتِ مِنْكُنَّ اَجْرًا عَظِيْمًا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa in kuntunna turidnallāha wa rasūlahū wad-dāral-ākhirata fa innallāha a‘adda lil-muḥsināti minkunna ajran ‘aẓīmā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: but if you desire God and His Apostle, and [thus the good of] the life in the hereafter, then [know that], verily, for the doers of good among you God has readied a mighty reward!”

ayahs.textArabic: يٰنِسَاۤءَ النَّبِيِّ مَنْ يَّأْتِ مِنْكُنَّ بِفَاحِشَةٍ مُّبَيِّنَةٍ يُّضٰعَفْ لَهَا الْعَذَابُ ضِعْفَيْنِۗ وَكَانَ ذٰلِكَ عَلَى اللّٰهِ يَسِيْرًا   ۔
ayahs.textLatin: Yā nisā'an-nabiyyi may ya'ti minkunna bifāḥisyatim mubayyinatiy yuḍā‘af lahal-‘ażābu ḍi‘fain(i), wa kāna żālika ‘alallāhi yasīrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: O wives of the Prophet! If any of you were to become guilty of manifestly immoral conduct, double [that of other sinners] would be her suffering [in the hereafter]: for that is indeed easy for God.

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَمَنْ يَّقْنُتْ مِنْكُنَّ لِلّٰهِ وَرَسُوْلِهٖ وَتَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا نُّؤْتِهَآ اَجْرَهَا مَرَّتَيْنِۙ وَاَعْتَدْنَا لَهَا رِزْقًا كَرِيْمًا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa may yaqnut minkunna lillāhi wa rasūlihī wa ta‘mal ṣāliḥan nu'tihā ajrahā marratain(i), wa a‘tadnā lahā rizqan karīmā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: But if any of you devoutly obeys God and His Apostle and does good deeds, on her shall We bestow her reward twice-over: for We shall have readied for her a most excellent sustenance [in the life to come].

ayahs.textArabic: يٰنِسَاۤءَ النَّبِيِّ لَسْتُنَّ كَاَحَدٍ مِّنَ النِّسَاۤءِ اِنِ اتَّقَيْتُنَّ فَلَا تَخْضَعْنَ بِالْقَوْلِ فَيَطْمَعَ الَّذِيْ فِيْ قَلْبِهٖ مَرَضٌ وَّقُلْنَ قَوْلًا مَّعْرُوْفًاۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Yā nisā'an-nabiyyi lastunna ka'aḥadim minan-nisā'i inittaqaitunna falā takhḍa‘na bil-qauli fa yaṭma‘al-lażī fī qalbihī maraḍuw wa qulna qaulam ma‘rūfā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: O wives of the Prophet! You are not like any of the [other] women, provided that you remain [truly] conscious of God. Hence, be not over-soft in your speech, lest any whose heart is diseased should be moved to desire [you]: but, withal, speak in a kindly way.

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَرْنَ فِيْ بُيُوْتِكُنَّ وَلَا تَبَرَّجْنَ تَبَرُّجَ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ الْاُوْلٰى وَاَقِمْنَ الصَّلٰوةَ وَاٰتِيْنَ الزَّكٰوةَ وَاَطِعْنَ اللّٰهَ وَرَسُوْلَهٗ ۗاِنَّمَا يُرِيْدُ اللّٰهُ لِيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمُ الرِّجْسَ اَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ وَيُطَهِّرَكُمْ تَطْهِيْرًاۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qarna fī buyūtikunna wa lā tabarrajna tabarrujal-jāhiliyyatil-ūlā wa aqimnaṣ-ṣalāta wa ātīnaz-zakāta wa aṭi‘nallāha wa rasūlah(ū), innamā yurīdullāhu liyużhiba ‘ankumur-rijsa ahlal-baiti wa yuṭahhirakum taṭhīrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: And abide quietly in your homes, and do not flaunt your charms as they used to flaunt them in the old days of pagan ignorance; and be constant in prayer, and render the purifying dues, and pay heed unto God and His Apostle: for God only wants to remove from you all that might be loathsome, O you members of the [Prophet’s] household, and to purify you to utmost purity.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاذْكُرْنَ مَا يُتْلٰى فِيْ بُيُوْتِكُنَّ مِنْ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَالْحِكْمَةِۗ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ لَطِيْفًا خَبِيْرًا ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Ważkurna mā yutlā fī buyūtikunna min āyātillāhi wal-ḥikmah(ti), innallāha kāna laṭīfan khabīrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: And bear in mind all that is recited in your homes of God’s messages and [His] wisdom: for God is unfathomable [in His wisdom], all-aware.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ الْمُسْلِمِيْنَ وَالْمُسْلِمٰتِ وَالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنٰتِ وَالْقٰنِتِيْنَ وَالْقٰنِتٰتِ وَالصّٰدِقِيْنَ وَالصّٰدِقٰتِ وَالصّٰبِرِيْنَ وَالصّٰبِرٰتِ وَالْخٰشِعِيْنَ وَالْخٰشِعٰتِ وَالْمُتَصَدِّقِيْنَ وَالْمُتَصَدِّقٰتِ وَالصَّاۤىِٕمِيْنَ وَالصّٰۤىِٕمٰتِ وَالْحٰفِظِيْنَ فُرُوْجَهُمْ وَالْحٰفِظٰتِ وَالذّٰكِرِيْنَ اللّٰهَ كَثِيْرًا وَّالذّٰكِرٰتِ اَعَدَّ اللّٰهُ لَهُمْ مَّغْفِرَةً وَّاَجْرًا عَظِيْمًا
ayahs.textLatin: Innal-muslimīna wal-muslimāti wal-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti wal-qānitīna wal-qānitāti waṣ-ṣādiqīna waṣ-ṣādiqāti waṣ-ṣābirīna waṣ-ṣābirāti wal-khāsyi‘īna wal-khāsyi‘āti wal-mutaṣaddiqīna wal-mutaṣaddiqāti waṣ-ṣā'imīna waṣ-ṣā'imāti wal-ḥāfiẓīna furūjahum wal-ḥāfiẓāti waż-żākirīnallāha kaṡīraw waż-żākirāti a‘addallāhu lahum magfirataw wa ajran ‘aẓīmā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: VERILY, for all men and women who have sur­rendered themselves unto God, and all believing men and believing women, and all truly devout men and truly devout women, and all men and women who are true to their word, and all men and women who are patient in adversity, and all men and women who humble themselves [before God], and all men and women who give in charity, and all self-denying men and self-denying women, and all men and women who are mindful of their chastity, and all men and women who remember God unceasingly: for [all of] them has God readied forgiveness of sins and a mighty reward.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا كَانَ لِمُؤْمِنٍ وَّلَا مُؤْمِنَةٍ اِذَا قَضَى اللّٰهُ وَرَسُوْلُهٗٓ اَمْرًا اَنْ يَّكُوْنَ لَهُمُ الْخِيَرَةُ مِنْ اَمْرِهِمْ ۗوَمَنْ يَّعْصِ اللّٰهَ وَرَسُوْلَهٗ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ ضَلٰلًا مُّبِيْنًاۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā kāna limu'miniw wa lā mu'minatin iżā qaḍallāhu wa rasūluhū amran ay yakūna lahumul-khiyaratu min amrihim, wa may ya‘ṣillāha wa rasūlahū faqad ḍalla ḍalālam mubīnā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Now whenever God and His Apostle have decided a matter, it is not for a believing man or a believing woman to claim freedom of choice insofar as they themselves are concerned: for he who [thus] rebels against God and His Apostle has already, most obviously, gone astray.

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذْ تَقُوْلُ لِلَّذِيْٓ اَنْعَمَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَاَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ اَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَاتَّقِ اللّٰهَ وَتُخْفِيْ فِيْ نَفْسِكَ مَا اللّٰهُ مُبْدِيْهِ وَتَخْشَى النَّاسَۚ وَاللّٰهُ اَحَقُّ اَنْ تَخْشٰىهُ ۗ فَلَمَّا قَضٰى زَيْدٌ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًاۗ زَوَّجْنٰكَهَا لِكَيْ لَا يَكُوْنَ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ حَرَجٌ فِيْٓ اَزْوَاجِ اَدْعِيَاۤىِٕهِمْ اِذَا قَضَوْا مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًاۗ وَكَانَ اَمْرُ اللّٰهِ مَفْعُوْلًا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iż taqūlu lil-lażī an‘amallāhu ‘alaihi wa an‘amta  ‘alaihi amsik ‘alaika zaujaka wattaqillāha wa tukhfī fī nafsika  mallāhu mubdīhi wa takhsyan-nās(a), wallāhu aḥaqqu an takhsyāh(u), falammā qaḍā zaidum minhā waṭaran zawwajnākahā likai lā yakūna ‘alal-mu'minīna ḥarajun fī azwāji ad‘iyā'ihim iżā qaḍau minhunna waṭarā(n), wa kāna amrullāhi maf‘ūlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: AND LO, [O Muhammad,] thou didst say unto the one to whom God had shown favour and to whom thou hadst shown favour, “Hold on to thy wife, and remain conscious of God!” And [thus] wouldst thou hide within thyself something that God was about to bring to light for thou didst stand in awe of [what] people [might think], whereas it was God alone of whom thou shouldst have stood in awe! [But] then, when Zayd had come to the end of his union with her, We gave her to thee in marriage, so that [in future] no blame should attach to the be­lievers for [marrying] the spouses of their adopted children when the latter have come to the end of their union with them. And [thus] God’s will was done.

ayahs.textArabic: مَا كَانَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ مِنْ حَرَجٍ فِيْمَا فَرَضَ اللّٰهُ لَهٗ ۗسُنَّةَ اللّٰهِ فِى الَّذِيْنَ خَلَوْا مِنْ قَبْلُ ۗوَكَانَ اَمْرُ اللّٰهِ قَدَرًا مَّقْدُوْرًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Mā kāna ‘alan-nabiyyi min ḥarajin fīmā faraḍallāhu lah(ū), sunnatallāhi fil-lażīna khalau min qabl(u), wa kāna amrullāhi qadaram maqdūrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Hence,] no blame whatever attaches to the Prophet for [having done] what God has ordained for him. [Indeed, such was] God’s way with those that have passed away aforetime and [remember that] God’s will is always destiny absolute-;

ayahs.textArabic: ۨالَّذِيْنَ يُبَلِّغُوْنَ رِسٰلٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَيَخْشَوْنَهٗ وَلَا يَخْشَوْنَ اَحَدًا اِلَّا اللّٰهَ ۗوَكَفٰى بِاللّٰهِ حَسِيْبًا
ayahs.textLatin: Allażīna yuballigūna risālātillāhi wa yakhsyaunahū wa lā yakhsyauna aḥadan illallāh(a), wa kafā billāhi ḥasībā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [and such will always be His way with] those who convey God’s messages [to the world], and stand in awe of Him, and hold none but God in awe: for none can take count [of man’s doings] as God does!

ayahs.textArabic: مَا كَانَ مُحَمَّدٌ اَبَآ اَحَدٍ مِّنْ رِّجَالِكُمْ وَلٰكِنْ رَّسُوْلَ اللّٰهِ وَخَاتَمَ النَّبِيّٖنَۗ وَكَانَ اللّٰهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيْمًا ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Mā kāna muḥammadun abā aḥadim mir rijālikum wa lākir rasūlallāhi wa khātaman-nabiyyīn(a), wa kānallāhu bikulli syai'in ‘alīmā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And know, O believers, that] Muhammad is not the father of any one of your men, but is God’s Apostle and the Seal of all Prophets. And God has indeed full knowledge of everything.

ayahs.textArabic: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوا اذْكُرُوا اللّٰهَ ذِكْرًا كَثِيْرًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Yā ayyuhal-lażīna āmanużkurullāha żikran kaṡīrā(n),
ayahs.textEnglish: O YOU who have attained to faith! Remember God with unceasing remembrance,

ayahs.textArabic: وَّسَبِّحُوْهُ بُكْرَةً وَّاَصِيْلًا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa sabbiḥūhu bukrataw wa aṣīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and extol His limitless glory from morn to evening.

ayahs.textArabic: هُوَ الَّذِيْ يُصَلِّيْ عَلَيْكُمْ وَمَلٰۤىِٕكَتُهٗ لِيُخْرِجَكُمْ مِّنَ الظُّلُمٰتِ اِلَى النُّوْرِۗ وَكَانَ بِالْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ رَحِيْمًا
ayahs.textLatin: Huwal-lażī yuṣallī ‘alaikum wa malā'ikatahū liyukhrijakum minaẓ-ẓulumāti ilan-nūr(i), wa kāna bil-mu'minīna raḥīmā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: He it is who bestows His blessings upon you, with His angels [echoing Him], so that He might take you out of the depths of darkness into the light. And, indeed, a dispenser of grace is He unto the believers.

ayahs.textArabic: تَحِيَّتُهُمْ يَوْمَ يَلْقَوْنَهٗ سَلٰمٌ ۚوَاَعَدَّ لَهُمْ اَجْرًا كَرِيْمًا
ayahs.textLatin: Taḥiyyatuhum yauma yalqaunahū salām(un), wa a‘adda lahum ajran karīmā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: On the Day when they meet Him, they will be welcomed with the greeting, “Peace”; and He will have readied for them a most excellent reward.

ayahs.textArabic: يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ اِنَّآ اَرْسَلْنٰكَ شَاهِدًا وَّمُبَشِّرًا وَّنَذِيْرًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Yā ayyuhan-nabiyyu innā arsalnāka syāhidaw wa mubasysyiraw wa nażīrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And as for thee,] O Prophet - behold, We have sent thee as a witness [to the truth], and as a herald of glad tidings and a warner,

ayahs.textArabic: وَّدَاعِيًا اِلَى اللّٰهِ بِاِذْنِهٖ وَسِرَاجًا مُّنِيْرًا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa dā‘iyan ilallāhi bi'iżnihī wa sirājam munīrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and as one who summons [all men] to God by His leave, and as a light-giving beacon.

ayahs.textArabic: وَبَشِّرِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ بِاَنَّ لَهُمْ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ فَضْلًا كَبِيْرًا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa basysyiril-mu'minīna bi'anna lahum minallāhi faḍlan kabīrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: And [so,] convey to the believers the glad tiding that a great bounty from God awaits them;

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَا تُطِعِ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ وَالْمُنٰفِقِيْنَ وَدَعْ اَذٰىهُمْ وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللّٰهِ ۗوَكَفٰى بِاللّٰهِ وَكِيْلًا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa lā tuṭi‘il-kāfirīna wal-munāfiqīna wa da‘ ażāhum wa tawakkal ‘alallāh(i), wa kafā billāhi wakīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and defer not to [the likes and dislikes of] the deniers of the truth and the hypocrites, and disregard their hurtful talk, and place thy trust in God: for none is as worthy of trust as God.

ayahs.textArabic: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْٓا اِذَا نَكَحْتُمُ الْمُؤْمِنٰتِ ثُمَّ طَلَّقْتُمُوْهُنَّ مِنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ تَمَسُّوْهُنَّ فَمَا لَكُمْ عَلَيْهِنَّ مِنْ عِدَّةٍ تَعْتَدُّوْنَهَاۚ فَمَتِّعُوْهُنَّ وَسَرِّحُوْهُنَّ سَرَاحًا جَمِيْلًا
ayahs.textLatin: Yā ayyuhal-lażīna āmanū iżā nakaḥtumul-mu'mināti ṡumma ṭallaqtumūhunna min qabli an tamassūhunna famā lakum ‘alaihinna min ‘iddatin ta‘taddūnahā, fa matti‘ūhunna wa sarriḥūhunna sarāḥan jamīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: O YOU who have attained to faith! If you marry believing women and then divorce them ere you have touched them, you have no reason to expect, and to calculate, any waiting period on their part: hence, make [at once] provision for them, and release them in a becoming manner.

ayahs.textArabic: يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ اِنَّآ اَحْلَلْنَا لَكَ اَزْوَاجَكَ الّٰتِيْٓ اٰتَيْتَ اُجُوْرَهُنَّ وَمَا مَلَكَتْ يَمِيْنُكَ مِمَّآ اَفَاۤءَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيْكَ وَبَنٰتِ عَمِّكَ وَبَنٰتِ عَمّٰتِكَ وَبَنٰتِ خَالِكَ وَبَنٰتِ خٰلٰتِكَ الّٰتِيْ هَاجَرْنَ مَعَكَۗ وَامْرَاَةً مُّؤْمِنَةً اِنْ وَّهَبَتْ نَفْسَهَا لِلنَّبِيِّ اِنْ اَرَادَ النَّبِيُّ اَنْ يَّسْتَنْكِحَهَا خَالِصَةً لَّكَ مِنْ دُوْنِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَۗ قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا فَرَضْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ فِيْٓ اَزْوَاجِهِمْ وَمَا مَلَكَتْ اَيْمَانُهُمْ لِكَيْلَا يَكُوْنَ عَلَيْكَ حَرَجٌۗ وَكَانَ اللّٰهُ غَفُوْرًا رَّحِيْمًا
ayahs.textLatin: Yā ayyuhan-nabiyyu innā aḥlalnā laka azwājakal-lātī ātaita ujūrahunna wa mā malakat yamīnuka  mimmā afā'allāhu ‘alaika wa banāti ‘ammika wa banāti ‘ammātika wa banāti khālika wa banāti khālātikal-lātī hājarna ma‘ak(a), wamra'atam mu'minatan iw wahabat nafsahā lin-nabiyyi in arādan-nabiyyu ay yastankiḥahā, khāliṣatal laka min dūnil-mu'minīn(a), qad ‘alimnā mā faraḍnā ‘alaihim fī azwājihim wa mā malakat aimānuhum likailā yakūna ‘alaika ḥaraj(un), wa kānallāhu gafūrar raḥīmā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: O PROPHET! Behold, We have made lawful to thee thy wives unto whom thou hast paid their dowers, as well as those whom thy right hand has come to possess from among the captives of war whom God has bestowed upon thee. And [We have made lawful to thee] the daughters of thy paternal uncles and aunts, and the daughters of thy maternal uncles and aunts, who have migrated with thee [to Yathrib]; and any believing woman who offers herself freely to the Prophet and whom the Prophet might be willing to wed: [this latter being but] a privilege for thee, and not for other believers - [seeing that] We have already made known what We have enjoined upon them with regard to their wives and those whom their right hands may possess. [And] in order that thou be not burdened with [undue] anxiety - for God is indeed much-forgiving, a dispenser of grace –

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ تُرْجِيْ مَنْ تَشَاۤءُ مِنْهُنَّ وَتُـْٔوِيْٓ اِلَيْكَ مَنْ تَشَاۤءُۗ وَمَنِ ابْتَغَيْتَ مِمَّنْ عَزَلْتَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكَۗ ذٰلِكَ اَدْنٰٓى اَنْ تَقَرَّ اَعْيُنُهُنَّ وَلَا يَحْزَنَّ وَيَرْضَيْنَ بِمَآ اٰتَيْتَهُنَّ كُلُّهُنَّۗ وَاللّٰهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِيْ قُلُوْبِكُمْ ۗوَكَانَ اللّٰهُ عَلِيْمًا حَلِيْمًا
ayahs.textLatin: Turjī man tasyā'u wa tu'wī ilaika man tasyā'(u), wa manibtagaita mimman ‘azalta falā junāḥa ‘alaik(a), żālika adnā an taqarra a‘yunuhunna wa lā yaḥzanna wa yarḍaina bimā ātaitahunna kulluhunn(a), wallāhu ya‘lamu mā fī qulūbikum, wa kānallāhu ‘alīman ḥalīmā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [know that] thou mayest put off for a time whichever of them thou pleasest, and mayest take unto thee whichever thou pleasest; and [that,] if thou seek out any from whom thou hast kept away [for a time], thou wilt incur no sin [thereby]: this will make it more likely that their eyes are gladdened [whenever they see thee], and that they do not grieve [whenever they are overlooked], and that all of them may find contentment in whatever thou hast to give them: for God [alone] knows what is in your hearts - and God is indeed all-knowing, for­bearing.

ayahs.textArabic: لَا يَحِلُّ لَكَ النِّسَاۤءُ مِنْۢ بَعْدُ وَلَآ اَنْ تَبَدَّلَ بِهِنَّ مِنْ اَزْوَاجٍ وَّلَوْ اَعْجَبَكَ حُسْنُهُنَّ اِلَّا مَا مَلَكَتْ يَمِيْنُكَۗ وَكَانَ اللّٰهُ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ رَّقِيْبًا ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Lā yaḥillu lakan-nisā'u mim ba‘du wa lā an tabaddala bihinna min azwājiw wa lau a‘jabaka ḥusnuhunna illā mā malakat yamīnuk(a), wa kānallāhu ‘alā kulli syai'ir raqībā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: No [other] women shall henceforth be lawful to thee nor art thou [allowed] to supplant [any of] them by other wives, even though their beauty should please thee greatly -: [none shall be lawful to thee] beyond those whom thou [already] hast come to possess. And God keeps watch over everything.

ayahs.textArabic: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَدْخُلُوْا بُيُوْتَ النَّبِيِّ اِلَّآ اَنْ يُّؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ اِلٰى طَعَامٍ غَيْرَ نٰظِرِيْنَ اِنٰىهُ وَلٰكِنْ اِذَا دُعِيْتُمْ فَادْخُلُوْا فَاِذَا طَعِمْتُمْ فَانْتَشِرُوْا وَلَا مُسْتَأْنِسِيْنَ لِحَدِيْثٍۗ اِنَّ ذٰلِكُمْ كَانَ يُؤْذِى النَّبِيَّ فَيَسْتَحْيٖ مِنْكُمْ ۖوَاللّٰهُ لَا يَسْتَحْيٖ مِنَ الْحَقِّۗ وَاِذَا سَاَلْتُمُوْهُنَّ مَتَاعًا فَسْـَٔلُوْهُنَّ مِنْ وَّرَاۤءِ حِجَابٍۗ ذٰلِكُمْ اَطْهَرُ لِقُلُوْبِكُمْ وَقُلُوْبِهِنَّۗ وَمَا كَانَ لَكُمْ اَنْ تُؤْذُوْا رَسُوْلَ اللّٰهِ وَلَآ اَنْ تَنْكِحُوْٓا اَزْوَاجَهٗ مِنْۢ بَعْدِهٖٓ اَبَدًاۗ اِنَّ ذٰلِكُمْ كَانَ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ عَظِيْمًا
ayahs.textLatin: Yā ayyuhal-lażīna āmanū lā tadkhulū buyūtan-nabiyyi illā ay yu'żana lakum ilā ṭa‘āmin gaira nāẓirīna ināhu wa lākin iżā du‘ītum fadkhulū fa iżā ṭa‘imtum fantasyirū wa lā musta'nisīna liḥadīṡ(in), inna żālikum kāna yu'żin-nabiyya fayastaḥyī minkum, wallāhu lā yastaḥyī minal-ḥaqq(i), wa iżā sa'altumūhunna  matā‘an fas'alūhunna miw warā'i ḥijāb(in), żālikum aṭharu liqulūbikum wa qulūbihinn(a), wa mā kāna lakum an tu'żū rasūlallāhi wa lā an tankiḥū azwājahū mim ba‘dihī abadā(n), inna żālikum kāna ‘indallāhi ‘aẓīmā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: O YOU who have attained to faith! Do not enter the Prophet’s dwellings unless you are given leave; [and when invited] to a meal, do not come [so early as] to wait for it to be readied: but whenever you are invited, enter [at the proper time]; and when you have partaken of the meal, disperse without lingering for the sake of mere talk: that, behold, might give offence to the Prophet, and yet he might feel shy of [asking] you [to leave]: but God is not shy of [teaching you] what is right. And [as for the Prophet’s wives,] whenever you ask them for anything that you need, ask them from behind a screen: this will but deepen the purity of your hearts and theirs. Moreover, it does not behove you to give offence to God’s Apostle - just as it would not behove you ever to marry his widows after he has passed away: that, verily, would be an enormity in the sight of God.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنْ تُبْدُوْا شَيْـًٔا اَوْ تُخْفُوْهُ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيْمًا
ayahs.textLatin: In tubdū syai'an au tukhfūhu fa'innallāha kāna bikulli syai'in ‘alīmā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Whether you do anything openly or in secret, [remember that,] verily, God has full knowledge of everything.

ayahs.textArabic: لَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْهِنَّ فِيْٓ اٰبَاۤىِٕهِنَّ وَلَآ اَبْنَاۤىِٕهِنَّ وَلَآ اِخْوَانِهِنَّ وَلَآ اَبْنَاۤءِ اِخْوَانِهِنَّ وَلَآ اَبْنَاۤءِ اَخَوٰتِهِنَّ وَلَا نِسَاۤىِٕهِنَّ وَلَا مَا مَلَكَتْ اَيْمَانُهُنَّۚ وَاتَّقِيْنَ اللّٰهَ ۗاِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيْدًا
ayahs.textLatin: Lā junāḥa ‘alaihinna fī ābā'ihinna wa lā abnā'ihinna wa lā ikhwānihinna wa lā abnā'i ikhwānihinna wa lā abnā'i akhawātihinna wa lā nisā'ihinna wa lā mā malakat aimānuhunn(a), wattaqīnallāh(a), innallāha kāna ‘alā kulli syai'in syahīdā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [However,] it is no sin for them [to appear freely] before their fathers, or their sons, or their brothers, or their brothers’ sons, or their sisters’ sons, or their womenfolk, or such [male slaves] as their right hands may possess. But [always, O wives of the Prophet,] remain con­scious of God - for, behold, God is witness unto everything.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ وَمَلٰۤىِٕكَتَهٗ يُصَلُّوْنَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّۗ  يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا صَلُّوْا عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُوْا تَسْلِيْمًا
ayahs.textLatin: Innallāha wa malā'ikatahū yuṣallūna ‘alan-nabiyy(i), yā ayyuhal-lażīna āmanū ṣallū ‘alaihi wa sallimū taslīmā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Verily, God and His angels bless the Prophet: [hence,] O you who have attained to faith, bless him and give yourselves up [to his guidance] in utter self-surrender!

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ الَّذِيْنَ يُؤْذُوْنَ اللّٰهَ وَرَسُوْلَهٗ لَعَنَهُمُ اللّٰهُ فِى الدُّنْيَا وَالْاٰخِرَةِ وَاَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا مُّهِيْنًا
ayahs.textLatin: Innal-lażīna yu'żūnallāha wa rasūlahū la‘anahumullāhu fid-dun-yā wal-ākhirati wa a‘adda lahum ‘ażābam muhīnā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Verily, as for those who [knowingly] affront God and His Apostle - God will reject them in this world and in the life to come; and shameful suffering will He ready for them.

ayahs.textArabic: وَالَّذِيْنَ يُؤْذُوْنَ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنٰتِ بِغَيْرِ مَا اكْتَسَبُوْا فَقَدِ احْتَمَلُوْا بُهْتَانًا وَّاِثْمًا مُّبِيْنًا ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wal-lażīna yu'żūnal-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti bigairi maktasabū faqadiḥtamalū buhtānaw wa iṡmam mubīnā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: And as for those who malign believing men and believing women without their having done any wrong - they surely burden themselves with the guilt of calumny, and [thus] with a flagrant sin!

ayahs.textArabic: يٰٓاَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُلْ لِّاَزْوَاجِكَ وَبَنٰتِكَ وَنِسَاۤءِ الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ يُدْنِيْنَ عَلَيْهِنَّ مِنْ جَلَابِيْبِهِنَّۗ ذٰلِكَ اَدْنٰىٓ اَنْ يُّعْرَفْنَ فَلَا يُؤْذَيْنَۗ وَكَانَ اللّٰهُ غَفُوْرًا رَّحِيْمًا
ayahs.textLatin: Yā ayyuhan-nabiyyu qul li'azwājika wa banātika wa nisā'il-mu'minīna yudnīna ‘alaihinna min jalābībihinn(a), żālika adnā ay yu‘rafna falā yu'żain(a), wa kānallāhu gafūrar raḥīmā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: O Prophet! Tell thy wives and thy daughters, as well as all [other] believing women, that they should draw over themselves some of their outer garments [when in public]: this will be more con­ducive to their being recognized [as decent women] and not annoyed. But [withal,] God is indeed much- forgiving, a dispenser of grace!

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ لَىِٕنْ لَّمْ يَنْتَهِ الْمُنٰفِقُوْنَ وَالَّذِيْنَ فِيْ قُلُوْبِهِمْ مَّرَضٌ وَّالْمُرْجِفُوْنَ فِى الْمَدِيْنَةِ لَنُغْرِيَنَّكَ بِهِمْ ثُمَّ لَا يُجَاوِرُوْنَكَ فِيْهَآ اِلَّا قَلِيْلًا
ayahs.textLatin: La'il lam yantahil-munāfiqūna wal-lażīna fī qulūbihim maraḍuw wal-murjifūna fil-madīnati lanugriyannaka bihim ṡumma lā yujāwirūnaka fīhā illā qalīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: THUS IT IS: if the hypocrites, and they in whose hearts is disease, and they who, by spreading false rumours, would cause disturbances in the City [of the Prophet] desist not [from their hostile doings]. We shall indeed give thee mastery over them, [O Muhammad] - and then they will not remain thy neighbours in this [city] for more than a little while:

ayahs.textArabic: مَلْعُوْنِيْنَۖ اَيْنَمَا ثُقِفُوْٓا اُخِذُوْا وَقُتِّلُوْا تَقْتِيْلًا
ayahs.textLatin: Mal‘ūnīn(a), ainamā ṡuqifū ukhiżū wa quttilū taqtīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: bereft of God’s grace, they shall be seized wherever they may be found, and slain one and all.

ayahs.textArabic: سُنَّةَ اللّٰهِ فِى الَّذِيْنَ خَلَوْا مِنْ قَبْلُ ۚوَلَنْ تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ اللّٰهِ تَبْدِيْلًا
ayahs.textLatin: Sunnatallāhi fil-lażīna khalau min qabl(u), wa lan tajida lisunnatillāhi tabdīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Such has been God’s way with those who [sinned in like manner and] passed away aforetime - and never wilt thou find any change in God’s way!

ayahs.textArabic: يَسْـَٔلُكَ النَّاسُ عَنِ السَّاعَةِۗ قُلْ اِنَّمَا عِلْمُهَا عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ ۗوَمَا يُدْرِيْكَ لَعَلَّ السَّاعَةَ تَكُوْنُ قَرِيْبًا
ayahs.textLatin: Yas'alukan-nāsu ‘anis-sā‘ah(ti), qul innamā ‘ilmuhā ‘indallāh(i), wa mā yudrīka la‘allas-sā‘ata takūnu qarībā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: PEOPLE will ask thee about the Last Hour. Say: “Knowledge thereof rests with God alone; yet for all thou knowest, the Last Hour may well be near!”

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَعَنَ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ وَاَعَدَّ لَهُمْ سَعِيْرًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Innallāha la‘anal-kāfirīna wa a‘adda lahum sa‘īrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Verily, God has rejected the deniers of the truth, and has readied for them a blazing fire,

ayahs.textArabic: خٰلِدِيْنَ فِيْهَآ اَبَدًاۚ  لَا يَجِدُوْنَ وَلِيًّا وَّلَا نَصِيْرًا ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Khālidīna fīhā abadā(n), lā yajidūna waliyyaw wa lā naṣīrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: therein to abide beyond the count of time: no protec­tor will they find, and none to bring them succour.

ayahs.textArabic: يَوْمَ تُقَلَّبُ وُجُوْهُهُمْ فِى النَّارِ يَقُوْلُوْنَ يٰلَيْتَنَآ اَطَعْنَا اللّٰهَ وَاَطَعْنَا الرَّسُوْلَا۠
ayahs.textLatin: Yauma tuqallabu wujūhuhum fin-nāri yaqūlūna yā laitanā aṭa‘nallāha wa aṭa‘nar-rasūlā.
ayahs.textEnglish: On the Day when their faces shall be tossed about in the fire, they will exclaim, “Oh, would that we had paid heed unto God, and paid heed unto the Apostle!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَقَالُوْا رَبَّنَآ اِنَّآ اَطَعْنَا سَادَتَنَا وَكُبَرَاۤءَنَا فَاَضَلُّوْنَا السَّبِيْلَا۠
ayahs.textLatin: Wa qālū rabbanā innā aṭa‘nā sādatanā wa kubarā'anā fa aḍallūnas-sabīlā.
ayahs.textEnglish: And they will say: “O our Sustainer! Behold, we paid heed unto our leaders and our great men, and it is they who have led us astray from the right path!

ayahs.textArabic: رَبَّنَآ اٰتِهِمْ ضِعْفَيْنِ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ وَالْعَنْهُمْ لَعْنًا كَبِيْرًا ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Rabbanā ātihim ḍi‘faini minal-‘ażābi wal‘anhum la‘nan kabīrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: O our Sustainer! Give them double suffering, and banish them utterly from Thy grace!”

ayahs.textArabic: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا لَا تَكُوْنُوْا كَالَّذِيْنَ اٰذَوْا مُوْسٰى فَبَرَّاَهُ اللّٰهُ مِمَّا قَالُوْا ۗوَكَانَ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ وَجِيْهًا ۗ
ayahs.textLatin: Yā ayyuhal-lażīna āmanū lā takūnū kal-lażīna āżau mūsā fa barra'ahullāhu mimmā qālū, wa kāna ‘indallāhi wajīhā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: O YOU who have attained to faith! Be not like those [children of Israel] who gave offence to Moses, and [remember that] God showed him to be innocent of whatever they alleged [against him or demanded of him]: for of great honour was he in the sight of God.

ayahs.textArabic: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَقُوْلُوْا قَوْلًا سَدِيْدًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Yā ayyuhal-lażīna āmanuttaqullāha wa qūlū qaulan sadīdā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: O you who have attained to faith! Remain conscious of God, and [always] speak with a will to bring out [only] what is just and true -

ayahs.textArabic: يُّصْلِحْ لَكُمْ اَعْمَالَكُمْ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوْبَكُمْۗ وَمَنْ يُّطِعِ اللّٰهَ وَرَسُوْلَهٗ فَقَدْ فَازَ فَوْزًا عَظِيْمًا
ayahs.textLatin: Yuṣliḥ lakum a‘mālakum wa yagfir lakum żunūbakum, wa may yuṭi‘illāha wa rasūlahū faqad fāza fauzan ‘aẓīmā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [whereupon] He will cause your deeds to be virtuous, and will forgive you your sins. And [know that] whoever pays heed unto God and His Apostle has already attained to a mighty triumph.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّا عَرَضْنَا الْاَمَانَةَ عَلَى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَالْجِبَالِ فَاَبَيْنَ اَنْ يَّحْمِلْنَهَا وَاَشْفَقْنَ مِنْهَا وَحَمَلَهَا الْاِنْسَانُۗ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ ظَلُوْمًا جَهُوْلًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Innā ‘araḍnal-amānata ‘alas-samāwāti wal-arḍi fa abaina ay yaḥmilnahā wa asyfaqna minhā wa ḥamalahal-insān(u), innahū kāna ẓalūman jahūlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Verily, We did offer the trust [of reason and volition] to the heavens, and the earth, and the mountains: but they refused to bear it because they were afraid of it. Yet man took it up - for, verily, he has always been prone to be most wicked, most foolish.

ayahs.textArabic: لِّيُعَذِّبَ اللّٰهُ الْمُنٰفِقِيْنَ وَالْمُنٰفِقٰتِ وَالْمُشْرِكِيْنَ وَالْمُشْرِكٰتِ وَيَتُوْبَ اللّٰهُ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ وَالْمُؤْمِنٰتِۗ وَكَانَ اللّٰهُ غَفُوْرًا رَّحِيْمًا ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Liyu‘ażżiballāhul-munāfiqīna wal-munāfiqāti wal-musyrikīna wal-musyrikāti wa yatūballāhu ‘alal-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināt(i), wa kānallāhu gafūrar raḥīmā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And so it is] that God imposes suffering on the hypocrites, both men and women, as well as on the men and women who ascribe divinity to aught beside Him. And [so, too, it is] that God turns in His mercy unto the believing men and believing women: for God is indeed much-forgiving, a dispenser of grace!
